Title: Freak Drive and Daring the Dawn burning the vampire

Messages.Author: Vincent
Messages.Body:
Vampire A is at 1 blood and is performing an unblocked action. A plays
Daring the Dawn at inferior.
Can A play Freak Drive at the end of the action, before taking the 2
agg damage?

Freak Drive
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Fortitude
Cost: 1 blood
[for] Only usable at the end of a successful action (after resolving
the action). This vampire untaps.
[FOR] As above, but usable even if the action is blocked (play after
combat, if any).

Daring the Dawn
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Fortitude
[for] Vampires cannot block this action. The acting vampire takes 2
unpreventable aggravated damage after the action resolves.
[FOR] As above, but the acting vampire takes 1 unpreventable
aggravated damage.

>[for] Vampires cannot block this action. The acting vampire takes 2
>unpreventable aggravated damage after the action resolves.

Doesn't the action resolve before Freak Drive is played? For instance
if the action is Legal Manipulations and the action is successful, the
bleed and pool gain are resolved before Freak Drive is played.

Or is the action only officially resolved after all what I would call
after-resolution action modifiers?

This is for anyone - please enlighten me about Freak Drive timing.
